confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several aggregator sources (Numbeo, Citycost, MyLifeElsewhere, Whereandwhen) that agree within about 15 percent, but they are crowd-sourced and not dated to July 2026. Beer and cocktail values are rough, cocktail rests on one Expatistan estimate, and wine_glass is inferred from the local beer price because no direct Lugano wine-by-the-glass data was found. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on live listings, and hotel prices in July peak season could be higher. CHF-to-USD values use an approximate rate that was not taken from the RBA observation. The FX value came from a search result summary of the RBA exchange rates page, not from the F11.1 data download.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced on Lugano and Ticino-specific aggregator data where available, cross-checked against Swiss price levels (Basel and Zurich-type data). Wine is inferred from the local beer price relationship. Accommodation is a model estimate based on Lugano's Swiss price level and summer tourism demand.
